unit: USD per million tokens, decimal strings with at most 4 fraction digits
note: Cache reads are 0.05x (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5) / 0.025x (Fable 5.1) / 0.1x (others) of input; writes 1.25x (5m) / 2x (1h). The 4.7+ tokenizer counts about 30% more tokens for the same text. A row with its own source was read on that date; the others carry the file source. promptTiers (schema v2, 2026-10-08): the row's rates apply to prompts up to each tier's aboveTokens, the tier's rates to longer prompts, output included. Claude Haiku 5.5 is the only current model priced by prompt length (more than 100,000 tokens). The docs say 'prompts over 100,000 tokens' without defining the count; this registry counts input + cache write + cache read tokens, the total input the prompt-caching and context-window docs define (read 2026-10-08), as the conservative reading. Batch API (50% off) is not used by this adapter.
